reason: Holds on the machine lens, with one correction to relies_on. Opcodes all real on the 65SC12 (LDA (zp) &B2, ORA zp, BNE, LDX #, ADC #); IF SKY_MODE = 0 / ENDIF is Baron syntax already used in render.6502; no SMC or label+n references to restore_block, each_part or no_part in src/; only caller is take_off (JSR at &998A), entered with C = 0 in SKY_MODE builds (sky_take_off's .no: CLC RTS; LDA #0 keeps C; BCS not taken), so ADC #&F8 / ADC #&FF gives the same rb_end as SEC/SBC #8/SBC #0; D is never set in the renderer. (v_ptr),Y reads are the same three plus LDA (zp), same page crossings, only the order changes. Recount (shipping, SKY_HELI=1, listing addresses): prefix -2 (SEC gone); copy 38 = 38; part 3 present: old LDA zp,X 4 + ORA zp,X 4 + BEQ untaken 2 = 10, new ORA zp 3 + BNE taken 3 (same page) = 6, -4; part 3 absent: old 4+4+BEQ taken 3+DEX 2+DEX 2+BPL taken crossing (&9E01 -> &9DCC) 4 = 19, new 3+2+2 = 7, -12. CORRECTION: relies_on says BEQ no_part stays in-page; it does not: new each_part = &9DD1, BEQ at &9DD5 (next &9DD7) to no_part &9E02 now crosses, so when part 2 is absent the taken BEQ costs 4, not 3 (+1). BPL each_part (&9E04 -> &9DD1) crossed before and still does. Worst path (part 3 present, part 2 absent) is still -2-4+1 = -5; best (both absent) -2-12+1 = -13; every path in the window is faster. Bytes: -1 (SEC) +6 (ORA zp, BNE, LDX #0) = +5 shipping (+6 with the CLC in SKY_HELI=0 builds), matching the claim's -5 saved (= grows by 5). Downstream shifts by +5 checked from the listing: branches changing crossing are exactly BEQ gathered &9EFD (stops, gain), BEQ out &A2F7 (starts, loss), plus the BEQ no_part above; indexed reads into moved bank 4 tables (ck_bank, ck_restore_lo/hi, wa_rows_guess, wa_rows_base_lo/hi, sky_heights-5, sprite_column_count) as relies_on lists; the net was measured by pcprof on built code (-14/-15 render cycles a pass), which includes all of these.
